text_overlay.text: Brutal reviews couldn't stop Other Mommy

sections.voiceover: Universal Pictures released the movie starring Jessica Chastain into North American cinemas. Where did the $27.5 million opening weekend come from?
b_roll: Universal Pictures logo and cinema marquee

sections.voiceover: Sony opened The Social Reckoning at the exact same time, but it crashed with a five point five million dollar launch.
That rival film pulled in a disappointing $5.5 million launch. Universal Pictures dominated the weekend completely. Other Mommy grabbed a massive $12.6 million on opening day alone.
